# PRAJWAL PHYSIOTHERAPY

> Physiotherapy and rehabilitation centre in Doddaballapura, Karnataka, providing personalised care to support movement, pain relief, recovery and everyday function.

## Website
- [Prajwal Physiotherapy](https://prajwalphysio.in/)

## Physiotherapy Services
- Orthopaedic Physiotherapy
- Sports Injury Rehabilitation
- Neurological Physiotherapy
- Home Physiotherapy
- Post-Surgical Rehabilitation
- Paediatric Physiotherapy
- Geriatric Physiotherapy
- Pain Management
- [Services](https://prajwalphysio.in/#services)

## Home Physiotherapy
- Home visit physiotherapy services are available within a 20 km radius of the centre.
- [Home Physiotherapy](https://prajwalphysio.in/#home-physiotherapy)
